summary: Tenant tag rename caused misrouted postbacks -> missing promo credit & autopay failure
description:
Issue summary:
Customer noticed an unexpected invoice charge and autopay failure after a tenant-level tag rename that happened during a scheduled plan migration. A subset of postbacks from a large multi-region batch embed job were routed with the old tenant tag, causing those postbacks to be credited to the wrong cost center. Promotional credits tied to the customer account were not applied to the invoice (they show as applied in the console UI but not on the finalized invoice), which triggered autopay to fail on the finalized cycle.

Impact:
- Finalized invoice for billing cycle 2026-02 shows a $9,420 line item from 'staging-rate' entries and a $-1,250 provisional credit missing.
- Autopay attempted on 2026-03-01 but failed due to insufficient applied credits causing customer account to show past-due.
- Customer billing contact is on hold for audit; they request an explanation and provisional credit while we investigate.

Environment:
- Prod (us-east), tenant DocuLogix main org, affected API key domain: proj-doculogix-prod (one key flagged in the first row of postback table).
- Plan change executed 2026-02-28 22:04 UTC (migration window).

Steps to reproduce / observed sequence:
1) 2026-02-28T21:58 UTC: large batch embed job kicked off targeting us-east with mixed-models; postbacks streamed to billing collector.
2) 2026-02-28T22:04 UTC: tenant tag rename performed (console action: change tenant tag from docu-legacy to doculogix-main) as part of plan migration.
3) 2026-02-28T22:04:02 - 22:06 UTC: collector service accepted ~1,800 postbacks; ~120 were tagged with old tenant id due to a brief cache miss in the tag-mapper.
4) 2026-03-01: billing finalized; invoice lines include charges attributed to old tenant tag and promo credits not applied.

Logs / snapshots attached in backend: billing/postbacks/2026-02-28/us-east/postbacks-22-04.log (snippet shows tag header mismatch), console audit 2026-02-28 22:04 (tenant-tag-change), postback-reconciler metrics for same minute shows 15% postback rejections before retry.

Initial hypothesis:
- Tag-mapper cache TTL expired at the exact time of the rename leading to a race where some postbacks used stale mapping and were attributed to the legacy tenant id.
- Promo credits are applied at invoice-finalization by matching tenant ids; misattributed postbacks caused credits to attach to the legacy tenant (now inactive), so the live tenant invoice appears without those credits.
- Autopay failed because effective balance remained above threshold after misattribution.

Requested next steps from Support/ENG:
- Engineering: confirm postback attribution and produce reconciler run to reassign misattributed postbacks to active tenant.
- Billing ops: produce provisional credit for customer while fix is validated.
- CS: notify customer with timeline and provide temporary waiver so autopay won't disrupt services.
comments: 2026-03-10 — Aisha Patel (Support): Acknowledged customer report. Opened ticket and requested logs from billing collector. Customer provided invoice PDF and console screenshots. Assigned to Billing eng: Diego.

2026-03-10 — Diego Alvarez (Billing Eng): Investigating. I can see a cluster of postbacks in postbacks-22-04.log with header 'X-Tenant-Tag: docu-legacy' immediately after the rename event. Hypothesis: tag-mapper cache TTL + rename race. Asking infra to provide tag-mapper cache TTL at 22:04 UTC.

2026-03-11 — Infra (comment via INT-2134): Tag-mapper TTL default is 60s; there was a brief cache miss while the rename propagated. No deploys at that time. Recommending reconciler replay for 120 postbacks to reassign tenant id.

2026-03-11 — Billing Ops (comment): We prepared a provisional credit flow; pending engineering sign-off to reassign postbacks. Proposed provisional credit: $1,250 applied to DocuLogix live tenant once reconciler completes and we confirm invoice re-aggregation.

2026-03-12 — Customer (DocuLogix - Maria Chen): Thank you. Please confirm that applying provisional credit won't affect our usage metrics dashboard; we need usage numbers unchanged for internal chargebacks. Also request ETA for final invoice correction.

2026-03-12 — Diego Alvarez (Billing Eng): Confirm that reconciler will only reattribute billing tags and will not modify raw usage metrics; it will update invoice attribution only. Reconciler ETA: run today 2026-03-12 17:00 UTC. Billing Ops to hold provisional credit until post-reconciler verification completes.
